integration_notes: Shared four-wheel physics rig; Beam Builder adds two independent animated trailing wheels.
Three LODs retain wheel, spring, axle and tool pivots. Unity wrapper uses metre scale 0.68 after FBX importer scale 100.
Tool tip follows forward-cone aim assistance. Original reusable chassis remains unchanged.
Runtime powers and reversible prop states are in WorkshopPower, CuttableProp, PropMeshSlice and WashableSurface.
